about: JEG-1180: shared vectors for the stale flag. pipelines/week_state.py source_week_status (Python) returns `expect` for every case; a JS twin (JEG-1178's stale badge) can pin to the same file. `now` is a UTC instant; expected_week is the content week of its New York day. Rule (Jeremy, 2026-10-27, JEG-1176): a source still serving week N after Thursday 12:00 CT of week N+1 is stale; before that it is lagging. A warning, never a chain failure. Content week 8 opens Tue 2026-10-27 (CDT, UTC-5); week 9 opens Tue 2026-11-03 (CST, UTC-6, DST ended 2026-11-01).

cases.name: Tuesday 08:00 CT, source still on week 7: lagging
Wednesday 12:00 CT, source still on week 7: lagging (normal)
Wednesday 12:00 CT, source on week 8: current
Thursday 00:30 CT (date is Thursday, before the cutoff): lagging
Thursday 12:01 CT, source on week 8: current
Two weeks behind on Tuesday: stale (its cutoff passed last week)
Monday 23:30 Eastern (Tuesday in UTC): still week 7, current
After DST ends: Thursday 11:59 CST (17:59 UTC) is lagging
After DST ends: Thursday 12:01 CST (18:01 UTC) is stale
No served week: unknown, never stale
Ahead of the calendar counts as current
